title: Jersey
desc: Arjun, a talented but failed cricketer, decides to return to cricket in his late thirties driven by the desire to represent the Indian cricket team and fulfil his son's wish for a jersey as a gift.

title: Thambikku Intha Ooru
desc: Akil, a restaurateur from Singapore, is taken aback after learning that he has been adopted and sets out on a journey to Chengalpet in order to find his biological parents.

title: Deiva Thirumagal
desc: Krishna, a man with intellectual disability, fights for the custody of his young daughter Nila. He convinces lawyer Anuradha to fight his case, when his father-in-law takes his daughter away from him.

title: Joot Are You Ready
desc: Easwaran, a young man from a small village, and his ailing father move in with his older brother in Chennai. However, things become complicated when he gets embroiled with local gangsters.

title: Thillalangadi
desc: Nisha leaves Krishna because of his easy-going attitude towards life and career. Soon, her parents arrange her marriage to an honest policeman, but her life takes a turn when she chances upon Krishna.
